edges.reason: msg.sender is used to gate one-per-wallet minting and as the mint recipient.
msg.sender determines mint recipient and contributes to the randomness seed.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random seed for part selection.
ownerOf(tokenId) is compared against msg.sender for authorization.
The payout winAmount is transferred directly to msg.sender.
The payout winAmount is transferred directly to msg.sender.
_safeMint to an attacker-controlled msg.sender triggers onERC721Received before counters are finalized.
block.timestamp is compared against tTimestamp + pPeriod to decide game termination.
hasPresaleStarted gates the presale branch of mintCharacter.
hasSaleStarted gates the public sale branch and presale exclusivity.
gameNotEnded modifier rejects calls once hasGameEnded is true.

charactersMinted enforces the presale and total character supply limits and derives the token id.
charactersMinted participates in deriving rocket part token ids.
rocketPartsMinted enforces the rocket part supply limit and is incremented per mint.
rocketPartsMinted forms the remaining supply used in the randomness calculation.
_characterMinted prevents a wallet from minting more than one character.
_tokenIdToMetadata is read indirectly through type/color validation of the burned parts.
_rocketPartSupply is decremented and used to select an available part type.
_rocketPartTypes is iterated to locate an available part type for the drawn index.
tTimestamp is read to compute the game end deadline.
hasSaleStarted must be true before rocket parts can be minted.
mintCharacter calls _safeMint before incrementing charactersMinted and setting _characterMinted.
mintRocketParts loops calling mintRandomRocketPart for each requested part.
mintRandomRocketPart calls _safeMint, invoking onERC721Received on the recipient.
claimEachRocketPartWin validates each token via validatePartType before burning.
claimFullSetOfColors delegates validation, burning and payout to validateColorsAndBurn.
validateColorsAndBurn validates each of the four color variants via validatePartType.
tokenURI calls tokenAttributes to build the attributes fragment.
mintCharacter forwards the full owner cut to the owner with transfer.
mintRocketParts forwards 20% of msg.value to the owner with transfer.
migration drains the contract balance to the owner when the game ends.
claimEachRocketPartWin transfers half the balance to the caller.
validateColorsAndBurn transfers a percentage of the balance to the caller.
onERC721Received can reenter mintCharacter before mint state is recorded.
onERC721Received can reenter mintRocketParts during the mint loop.
